definitions.explanation: A small adhesive label purchased from a post office and attached to mail as proof of postage payment.

examples.japanese: {切手|きって}を{買|か}いたいです。
この{手紙|てがみ}に{切手|きって}を{貼|は}ってください。
examples.english: Please put a stamp on this letter.

examples.japanese: {八十|はちじゅう}{円|えん}の{切手|きって}をください。

notes:
{切手|きって} is a postage stamp affixed to mail as proof of payment.

COUNTER:
Use {枚|まい}: {一|いち}{枚|まい}, {二|に}{枚|まい}, {三|さん}{枚|まい}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {切手|きって}を{貼|は}る: to affix/stick a stamp
- {切手|きって}を{買|か}う: to buy stamps
- {切手|きって}を{集|あつ}める: to collect stamps
- ～{円|えん}{切手|きって}: ~yen stamp

WHERE TO BUY:
- {郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}: post office
- コンビニ: convenience stores

RELATED:
- {記念|きねん}{切手|きって}: commemorative stamp
- {切手|きって}{収集|しゅうしゅう}: stamp collecting
- {消印|けしいん}: postmark
